claim: The current diagnostic initramfs can bind the Oriole polling touchscreen, but it is not yet safe to hand off to a normal Omarchy desktop because the matching touch-supply hold module cannot resolve its ACPM symbol.
oracle: A safe handoff requires the input device, touch-supply hold, recovery serial service and the guarded stage continuation marker to coexist; a failed module load must leave the phone recoverable without a forced partition write.

user_journey.scenario: The operator reboots the unlocked test Pixel 6 into the Linux diagnostic environment and expects a usable touch desktop; the recovery path must remain available if a driver experiment fails.
user_journey.expected: The device either reaches a responsive Omarchy desktop or remains in a recoverable Fastboot/serial state with the failure identified. No Android recovery slot is overwritten.

invariants: The input30 module vermagic matches the running 7.3.0-rc6-omamobile-oriole-m1 kernel.
The touch-supply hold module is not considered loaded when insmod reports an unresolved symbol.
The GUI handoff marker is not created while a required guard is missing.
gitnexus: serial-input30-gui-handoff.sh requires INPUT30_READY, SPI binding, the touch-supply hold module, a recovery serial service and read-only partition guards before stage continuation.
ast: The handoff script checks each prerequisite independently and does not treat a registered event device as proof of a complete desktop boot.

unit.red: insmod of oriole_touch_supply_hold.ko failed with unknown symbol devm_acpm_get_by_node (err -2).
unit.green: insmod of oriole-input30.ko succeeded and registered Oriole polling touchscreen as Linux event1; the result is diagnostic only.
cases: input module vermagic matches running kernel
INPUT30 identity reports chip 3648, firmware 0049 and panel geometry 2399x1079

boundaries: Mac4 USB serial -> initramfs root shell -> kernel module loader -> SPI touch device
faults: ACPM symbol unavailable in running kernel
serial shell stopped executing after the ACPM load attempt
Fastboot was not enumerated by Mac4 during recovery
evidence: Fresh serial log observed INPUT30_READY and event1 registration.
Fresh serial log observed unknown symbol devm_acpm_get_by_node for oriole_touch_supply_hold.ko.
No stage continuation marker or normal desktop acceptance was claimed.

limitations: This checkpoint does not prove a persistent touch driver, GPU acceleration, Wi-Fi, cellular data, camera capture or a normal Omarchy desktop.
The failed experiment left the current diagnostic boot unresponsive and requires a physical power-cycle before another trial.
No partition, radio, calibration or Android recovery data was written in this checkpoint.
publication: No vendor firmware, calibration, credentials, private logs, MAC addresses, SSIDs, IMEIs or serial numbers are included.
next_gate: Power-cycle the phone, verify Fastboot/serial enumeration, then fix the ACPM symbol boundary or use a kernel-built touch-supply module before any GUI handoff.
